receipt.equivalence_review: A successful complete 16-block search, cross-checked byte-for-JSON-value against the pinned catalog, and empty wifi part search support the refusal. Original N2 requires Wi-Fi and explicitly excludes wired UART substitutions. UNSATISFIED_SELECTION/functions.wifi independently replays; no fabricated parts or failed-query-as-absence reasoning.

refusal.reason: The complete block search returned 16 catalog blocks, none in wireless.wifi and none implementing a Wi-Fi module; the part search for wifi returned no matches. The available UART header and USB-UART bridge provide wired interfaces only, explicitly excluded as equivalents by functions.wifi. Therefore the mandatory Wi-Fi function cannot be selected under the closed-world constraint.
